name: AssetType
description: Represents a class to allow specification of the asset product type.

assetType.description: Represents a filter based on the type of collateral asset.

debtType.description: Represents a filter based on the type of bond.

equityType.description: Represents a filter based on the type of equity.

fundType.description: Represents a filter based on the type of fund.

otherAssetType.description: Specifies the eligible asset type when not enumerated.

securityType.description: Represents a filter based on the type of security.
